about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (Ezekiel 37:15–28) joins two sticks, one for Judah and one for Joseph, into one, just as Judah and Joseph are reunited in this portion. It promises one people under one king, David, with God’s sanctuary among them forever. The reading from the Apostles (Acts 3:13–26) retells Joseph’s story: Shimon Kefa (Peter) tells his brothers that the one they handed over in ignorance is the Servant God has glorified, and through him life and blessing now come to them and to all the families of the earth.
